searchText: MSRP $295,290. The 2026 Newmar Bay Star 3225 for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. For the Dates August 14th through November 15th. Customer cash incentive must be used as down payment or applied as a discount toward the purchase of any new 2026 or older Baystar or Baystar Sport currently in stock and retailed during the program period and will be earned in the following amount: $10,000 Features Full-Wall Slide Booth Dinette Rear Ladder Solar Prep Continuous Hot Water Heater Winegard Rayzar Auto Antenna Folding Cockpit Table Bose Solo Sound Bar More About This RV Make each trip luxurious in this spacious coach that can sleep five to six people each night. You will wake up feeling refreshed after sleeping on the king bed slide out, and your guests can put away their bedding after sleeping on the sofa comfort lounge and booth dinette. Breakfast can be made on the three burner cooktop or in the 30' convection microwave. You will appreciate the pantry and a Norcold 10 cu. ft. refrigerator for your food, plus there is a second pantry/storage that will be perfect for snacks. This model also includes a shirt wardrobe in the bedroom, along with a dresser so you can bring along your favorite outfits. And you'll never go bored with Samsung LED TV's in the bedroom and living area! Each Bay Star Class A gas motorhome by Newmar delivers a smooth ride thanks to the standard electronic stability control, along with the 7.3-liter V8 engine with 335 HP and 468 lb./ft. of torque. The exterior is sure to turn heads with its full-paint Masterpiece Finish and new graphics packages, plus you'll have three interior decor choices and three wood choices to truly make the coach your own. Each model includes Williamsburg furniture, woven material in the slide outs, luxurious vinyl plank flooring, polished solid surface countertops in the kitchen, plus many more comforts. Head outside to find lights in the storage compartments, a 5.5kW Cummins Onan generator with remote switch, and hydraulic leveling jacks with a Bluetooth compatible touch pad for set up easy as 1-2-3! You can further customize your coach with the many options that are offered!
